narrative.overview:
This is one building's notice board and the conversation around it, kept in plain sight. The page is white (or night navy in dark mode), the writing is ink, and titles are strong enough to scan from across the room. Sun gold marks the places where a resident can act and the notices management pins up. The half-disc mark stands for management's own voice. Moderation lives in the same open layout as everything else: which rule applied, what happens next, who decides, and how past appeals changed the rules.

The visual world is the Sunshine brand kit, recoloured on 2026-11-08 from the kit's orange to a golden sun on cool ink and navy neutrals, set in Be Vietnam Pro, in the style of Reddit's light mode: a white page, posts as an open list split by hairlines, grey pill buttons, and a light grey side panel. Only notices, forms and page sections sit in bordered cards. Each channel has a Steam-library-style artwork banner: a deep navy field with the gold half-disc mark arranged differently per channel. Dark mode is night navy, never near-black, and swaps shadows for hairline edges. The resident journey and the manager moderation dashboard share one shell, one set of tokens and one component kit. A prototype role switch moves between them.

Density is a reading forum. Residents default to Lớn (root 100%, body 17px) and staff to Vừa (90%, about 15px) until someone picks a size. The size is chosen once in the welcome card and any time from a labelled "Aa Cỡ chữ" pill (Rất lớn is 112.5%), and it is stored per device. Bottom-nav labels follow it (at least 13px, wrapping to two lines). Every target is at least 44px. The confirmed rejections are card-grid dashboards, decorative gradients and stripes, a punitive moderation tone, the earlier pine green look, and orange on near-black (the owner rejected it because it recalls an adult site's branding).
keyCharacteristics: Sun gold on ink and navy neutrals; one warm signal on a cool page.
One family, Be Vietnam Pro, with strong titles over quiet grey metadata.
Hairline-divided lists on a flat page; cards only where something is pinned, filled in, or decided.
Management notices look like printed notices: a sun-gold header band, a ruled fact form, a dashed tear line.
Vivid avatars and colour-coded decision icons make people and outcomes easy to tell apart.
Light by default, a stored night-navy dark theme, and a stored text size per device.

rules.name: The One Warm Signal Rule
rules.body: Sun gold means "act here" or "management posted this". It never decorates empty space, and text on it is always ink-950. Pills on a gold or red band are white with ink text; never a dark pill with sun-coloured text.

rules.name: The Outcome Colour Rule
rules.body: Teal and red appear only as the small icon discs and soft tints of decision buttons, plus red for the emergency level and errors. Both outcome buttons stay the same size and weight.

rules.name: The Highlight Is Not A Notice Rule
rules.body: Pale blue marks where the reader landed (a linked comment, a rule, a search hit). Notices use the gold band.

rules.name: The Weight Before Size Rule
rules.body: Step hierarchy with weight first (400 to 600 to 700). Add size only for titles, and never shout with uppercase or letter-spaced kickers.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings use `text-wrap: balance` and prose uses `pretty`, so no line ends on a single word.

rules.name: The 44px Floor Rule
rules.body: Every tap target is at least 44px tall. Small radios and checkboxes sit inside rows that are at least 44px, and inline text links in metadata use padding on touch screens.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface casts a shadow only when it floats (a menu, dialog or toast) or when management pinned it (a notice). Lists and cards at rest use a hairline.

dos: Do make rephrasing the easy path: in any warning, "Sửa lại" is the primary and sending anyway is secondary.
Do mark every management post "Chính thức" beside the name, and add "Bài của cư dân, không phải tin chính thức của ban quản lý." to resident posts whose title or opening imitates management.
Do keep text on sun gold ink-950, and use `sun-700` (light) or `sun-300` (dark) for sun-coloured text.
Do make every target at least 44px, and keep radios and checkboxes inside 44px rows.
Do show a level pill, the date first, and a ruled fact form on every management notice.
Do show a preview and the recipient count before anything is emailed, and name "gửi email" on the button that sends it.
Do keep the two moderation outcomes the same size, coloured only by their icon disc and hover tint.
Do keep scrollbars thin and faint, and show panel scrollbars only on hover or keyboard focus.
Do cap page prose at 58ch and balance headings.
Do label sample data ("Dữ liệu mẫu", "Điểm mẫu") wherever numbers or scores appear.
donts: Don't use the earlier pine green, amber-tinted notice cards, or decorative stripes and gradients on surfaces.
Don't nest a bordered card inside a card. Use a soft or band block, or a ruled divider.
Don't fill the "Báo cáo" control or make it louder than the other actions.
Don't use teal or red as large fills outside the notice band, errors and the final danger button.
Don't add uppercase kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't shrink below the 90% root for body text or below 13px for any label.
